title: Change and quality control
description: Coordinates baselines, change authority, assurance, authoring guidance and improvement lessons.
responsibilities: Compose baseline management, change control, verification/assurance, authoring guidance, and learning so engineering decisions retain their applicable state, authority, and evidential basis.
Keep recording a decision distinct from deciding its authority or evidential adequacy, and preserve the separate roles of observations, judgments, and historical baselines.
Connect model-authoring guidance and reusable improvement lessons to the governing engineering meanings without duplicating the canonical model rules or published invocation procedures.

Provide IF-008 authoring guidance, IF-009 applicable action authority, and IF-010 claim/evidence applicability as distinct Governance contracts. MOD-008, MOD-006, and MOD-007 retain their behavioral contributions; MOD-005 consumes model-state inspection through IF-007 without duplicating parent consumption.
Provide IF-011 work-context/adoption cooperation through MOD-006, alongside IF-008 guidance, IF-009 authority and IF-010 evidence support for the requirement-first workflow.
Provide IF-014 assurance-content preparation through MOD-007 to MOD-012, composed with IF-010 evidence support and separate IF-009 authority; preparation does not retain records.
Compose SR020–024 under state-control.md: MOD005 baselines and MOD006 transition/retirement, with child IF016 exposed to guided recording and IF015 model custody.

Compose IR006 guidance and semantic task preparation/comparison through MOD008 IF008, then existing MOD007 IF014/010 assurance through MOD012; source selection and task results create no authority or retention.
Provide IF-017 through MOD-009 for supported lessons and improvement preparation; compose separate change-control, assurance and custody without parent ownership of child state.

includes: Governed engineering state evolution, baseline provenance, assurance interpretation, method-applicable authoring guidance, and assessed engineering improvement.
excludes: Definition storage and editing mechanisms, CLI admission and record publication, published capability invocation mechanics, and tool distribution.
Co-ownership of child-held baselines, evidence, judgments, guidance context, or lessons merely through containment.

design_limits: State-control.md supplies SR020–024 retention confirmation, comparison/recovery and transition/retirement cooperation. Full resumption/authority and other unassessed IR003 criteria, plus guidance/learning outside their selected IR006/IR007 scope, remain separate.

MOD-008 contributes semantic authoring guidance to IF-008; MOD-012 retains published invocation and specialist composition. IF-009 authority and IF-010 evidence support remain distinct from each other and from release qualification.

No parent Function/AR allocation, persistent state, verification execution, or physical realization is introduced by these contracts. Their presence does not complete the selected Scenarios end to end.

The requirement-first workflow design supplies the selected SR-079–083 collaboration and AR allocation. Earlier broader deferrals remain only outside that bounded extension; existing runtime observations and installed contracts do not implement the target design.

IR-004 assurance-content.md completes selected SCN-026–029 preparation and retention cooperation through existing Operations. Earlier wider assurance deferrals do not apply to that bounded Design; runtime guidance qualification remains separate.

IR006 guidance.md completes the selected guidance selection/correction and task assessment Design. Actual usability observations, installed instruction delivery and learning outside the selected IR007 scope remain separate.

sources.locator: MOD-017; children MOD-005, MOD-006, MOD-007, MOD-008, MOD-009

This is draft architecture, not implementation adoption or satisfaction.

sources.locator: MOD-017; SCN-019, SCN-053, SCN-066 selected collaboration analysis
sources.basis: Derive consumer-focused parent contracts for selected-state inspection, adopted-REM authoring guidance, applicable action authority, and evidence applicability. Preserve child behavior/state authority, existing Function/AR allocations, and earlier contract guarantees. The selected contracts refine prior blanket deferrals; remaining retention, wider collaboration, AR, and realization gaps stay explicit. This is draft design analysis, not implemented or satisfied behavior.
Draft integrated design from the accepted requirement-first basis. This defines target responsibility and cooperation, not installed capability, design approval, runtime evidence or SQLite adoption.

Derive assessor-assisted assurance preparation, explicit retention cooperation and scoped reliance through MOD-007 and IF-014. Preserve actual judgment, command and persistence ownership; target Design only.

Define immutable baseline custody, original-meaning comparison/recovery, attributable transition preparation and dependency-safe retirement. Preserve selective retention and separate action authority, operational maintenance and actual execution; proposed Design only.

Define source-bound guidance selection, bounded authoring/correction and participant-assisted semantic task assessment, with justified MOD-008 allocation and existing assurance/recording cooperation. Target Design only; no observed usability or installed capability claim.

Refine supported lesson characterization, bounded contextual use, accountable proposals and opportunity-based effect assessment through MOD-009 and parent IF-017. Preserve existing Learn confirmation/custody/route boundaries and separate controlled adoption, assurance and retention. Proposed Design only.
